visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a light green kohlrabi sitting on a dark stovetop surface. A pair of hands enters the frame using a metal peeler to remove the outer skin, revealing the white interior. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The kohlrabi is placed on a light wood cutting board. Hands use a stainless steel kitchen knife to slice the vegetable into three large sections. The camera remains in a steady close-up on the board. (3) One section is held steady while the knife makes several parallel vertical cuts that do not go all the way through the base. The hand is clearly visible guiding the blade with precision. (4) The pieces are then sliced horizontally, creating small, uniform cubes that remain partially attached due to the previous vertical cuts. A yellow text overlay appears at the bottom of the screen. (5) The cut vegetable pieces are placed into a metal pot. A hand sprinkles white granulated salt over them and then tosses the pieces to ensure an even coating for pickling. (6) Fresh red chilies and several cloves of garlic are placed on the cutting board and finely minced into small bits. The movement is fast and rhythmic. (7) In a white ceramic bowl, the minced garlic and chili are combined. Liquid seasonings are poured into the bowl from a glass bottle with a yellow cap and a prominent label. (8) The kohlrabi pieces are shown being rinsed under a kitchen tap and then squeezed firmly by hand over the white bowl to remove excess moisture. (9) The final dish is presented in a white bowl, showing the translucent vegetable cubes coated in a dark sauce with bits of red chili and garlic. A bottle of 'Doyoubo' soy sauce stands in the background.
